purpose: Dev-only prompt, floor-negative, aggregation and threshold selection for rug and bedroom-path relevance; unchanged ViT-B-32 encoder
split: Exact split and five CV group lists from scan/calibration.json, seed 7
labelAccess: Selection parses labels only for development image IDs; held-out labels are parsed only after a hash-bound selection lock is written
thresholdRule: At least two true positives. Maximize recall then precision then threshold, requiring recall >= 0.7 and precision >= 0.8. If infeasible, use precision >= 0.6 at recall >= 0.7. If still infeasible, abstain. Thresholds use midpoints between adjacent development scores to avoid a cut exactly on a training example.
selectionRule: Five-fold grouped development CV. Prefer candidates with pooled out-of-fold recall >= 0.7 and precision >= 0.8; otherwise require recall >= 0.7 and precision >= 0.6. Rank eligible candidates by F2, then AUROC, then precision, then declared order. Refit only the selected threshold on all development groups. If no candidate is eligible, retain the original item.
shipRule: For each selected item independently: held-out AUROC must not decrease (tolerance 1e-12), and recall must increase by at least 0.20 absolute compared with the shipped baseline. No alternate candidate may be chosen after held-out evaluation. Native parity must have zero threshold-decision mismatches. Otherwise retain the original item.
